items.requirement_zh: 城市设计应关注空间形态、公共空间、城市风貌
items.requirement_en: Urban design should focus on spatial form, public space, and urban character
items.response_zh: 历法主线作为连续公共空间系统，三个重点区分别形成不同风貌特征
items.response_en: Calendar spine as continuous public space system; three key areas with distinct character

items.standard_name_zh: 城市、镇控制性详细规划编制审批办法
items.standard_name_en: Regulatory Detailed Planning Compilation and Approval Measures
items.requirement_zh: 控规应明确用地性质、开发强度、配套设施
items.requirement_en: Regulatory plans should specify land use, development intensity, and supporting facilities
items.response_zh: 概念用地布局表明确功能比例，开发强度指标标为unknown并说明原因
items.response_en: Conceptual land use table specifies functional proportions; development intensity marked as unknown with reasons

items.standard_name_zh: 国土空间调查、规划、用途管制用地用海分类指南
items.requirement_zh: 用地分类应使用国标编码
items.requirement_en: Land use classification should use national standard codes
items.response_zh: 概念分区使用国标编码参考（0802、0804、05、07等），并明确标注为概念建议
items.response_en: Conceptual zones use national standard code references with clear conceptual notation
